description: The Estrella Polar continues across a transformed world as the survivors encounter new threats, unexplained visitors and evidence that they may not be as alone as they believed.

s02e01.description: The crew finally contacts astronauts trapped aboard the International Space Station and promises a sea rescue, even though a powerful cyclone is moving toward the planned splashdown point.

s02e02.description: A vast bloom of rapidly growing seaweed immobilizes the ship and conceals a venomous creature that attacks Piti, while clues in the recovered space capsule deepen the mystery.

s02e03.description: Floating supplies from the lost Queen America lead to four survivors covered in alarming lesions, forcing the captain to balance compassion against the risk of a deadly contagion.

s02e04.description: Strange cocoons clog the ship’s pipes as the newcomers tell their story, Vilma suffers a pregnancy scare and evidence mounts that the supposed castaways know more than they admit.

s02e05.description: Valeria and Ulises uncover evidence that the new passengers are secretly armed and communicating with outsiders, leading to an attempted takeover of the Estrella Polar.

s02e06.description: The powerless ship is dragged toward an enormous oceanic waterfall, while Julia reveals that Project Alexandria included another technologically advanced vessel that may hold the route to land.

s02e07.description: The crew prepares the Estrella Polar to survive the plunge over the waterfall, prompting Burbuja to risk himself to measure the drop and everyone else to confront unfinished personal business.

s02e08.description: Shaken by his violence toward Gamboa, Ulises swims away from the ship for solitude and drifts dangerously far, while an old film discovered aboard hints at the vessel’s hidden history.

s02e09.description: Palomares disappears beneath the sea after jumping overboard, leaving the crew racing to revive him and questioning whether his crisis of faith has pushed him beyond recovery.

s02e10.description: Tests on Manolito reveal that the duck was on solid ground only hours earlier, turning the injured animal into the crew’s best chance of finding land once Earth’s magnetic field stabilizes.

s02e11.description: A badly injured stowaway named Cristóbal is discovered hiding aboard, and his terror of whoever has been pursuing him suggests another threat is moving through the flooded world.

s02e12.description: An apparently identical training ship appears nearby, but the boarding party finds blood and signs of captives aboard, while Gamboa uses knowledge of Ulises’s past as leverage.

s02e13.description: A musical show briefly lifts the ship’s morale while divers secretly board, assault Sol and abduct De la Cuadra, forcing the captain to demand the truth from Julia.

s02e14.description: The crew improvises a Christmas and Three Kings celebration for Valeria despite their losses, while Ainhoa is absent and the adults struggle to preserve a little normality in the open ocean.
